analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md, with one added paragraph at head lines 1561-1569. It documents tokenizer byte-fallback decoding: LocalTokenizerBridge.decode releases trailing <0xHH> runs, partial runs read as U+FFFD, and DetokenizerV2 holds those back. The supplied base units (lines 4003-4494) lie in the unchanged part of the document, covering GLM and Qwen tensor parallel, the SSD prefix record encoding, and the GPT-OSS and Gemma notes. None of that text was modified. I checked it against the threat model, including T-041 (prefix cache), TB-007 and TB-002. The patch adds no code, configuration, endpoint, key handling, authorization, attestation or encryption change, so there are no new attack surfaces, changed assumptions or weakened mitigations. The added documentation does not claim any control change. The one remaining integration question is a real change to ProviderCore/Inference/Prompting/LocalTokenizerLoader.swift, which is not supplied here. If that change ships with this PR, it should be reviewed for output-handling and streaming correctness. The documented behavior is local detokenization of the provider's own output, and I see no confidentiality impact on A-001 from it. Residual uncertainty is limited to those unsupplied source files, not to this documentation diff.
